summary: Iteration 12 — tested the new Storefront funnel template end-to-end (templates -> create -> auto-attach -> publish -> public render), regression-tested the PublicFunnel REGISTRY refactor across all 6 legacy templates, verified the Preview compile error is gone, the /customers hook-order crash is fixed with working bulk-delete UI, the Funnel Editor product/coupon dropdowns + testimonial JSON editor, and ran the auth playbook checks. 18/21 backend assertions pass. ONE CRITICAL backend bug found: public funnel block hydration is completely broken (product AND coupon) because `workspace_id` is projected out of the Mongo query before it is used for the workspace-scoped lookup — so the storefront public page shows a placeholder 'Buy now' card with no product name/price/image even when a product IS attached. This is also a REGRESSION for every existing coupon-block funnel.

critical.issue: Block hydration NEVER works. Line 452 projects workspace_id OUT (`{"_id":0,"workspace_id":0,"created_by":0}`), then line 460 does `workspace_id = d.get('workspace_id')` -> always None. Every hydration lookup (`db.products.find_one({..., 'workspace_id': None})`, `db.coupons.find_one({..., 'workspace_id': None})`) matches nothing, so props.product and props.coupon are never set. Verified live: funnel qa-storefront-live has product_id=2b47512b… and coupon_code=VIPELITJRIXE attached, yet the public payload returns only {'product_id','coupon_code'} with no hydrated objects. REGRESSION: existing coupon-block funnels (diamond/noir/emerald/electric) also stopped hydrating. FIX: keep workspace_id in the projection (drop it from the projection dict), read it, then `d.pop('workspace_id', None)` at the end (that pop already exists at line 488).

minor.issue: Cross-tenant isolation could NOT be positively verified because hydration is dead (nothing hydrates for anyone, so the test vacuously 'passes'). Re-run the cross-tenant test AFTER the workspace_id fix — the scoping code itself looks correct.

Dead/confusing code: `raise HTTPException(400, 'Not found') if False else HTTPException(404, 'Not found')` in verify_domain. Works by accident; should be a plain `raise HTTPException(404, 'Not found')`.

Only handles coupon.type 'percentage' and 'fixed'. Real workspace coupons use the 23-type taxonomy (e.g. type='vip' with discount_value=20.0), so the strike-through discounted price will NEVER render for real coupons. Needs to map discount_type/discount_value or the library taxonomy.

ui_bugs.issue: Renders headline 'Buy now', 'Product image' placeholder and no price even though a real product is attached — direct user-visible fallout of the backend hydration bug, not a frontend defect. Will self-resolve once /api/public/f/{slug} hydrates props.product.

issues: Video block with an empty url renders a 64px-tall empty section, leaving a dead vertical gap between hero and countdown. Either hide the block when url is blank or render a poster/placeholder frame.

Storefront template ships video.url = '' so the 'video hero' promised by the feature is invisible by default — consider a default poster or an inline 'Add your video URL' editor hint on the public preview.
Countdown 'Countdown ends at' uses the browser-native datetime-local picker instead of the shadcn calendar/date-time component used elsewhere — inconsistent with the design system.

React dev-console warning on the product <select>: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' (injected by the dev instrumentation wrapper on the dynamic option text). Harmless in prod but noisy; consider a non-dynamic option label render.

This single line breaks the entire storefront feature AND regresses all coupon-block funnels.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE (single line): /app/backend/routers/funnels.py, public_funnel(). The Mongo query at line ~452 uses projection {"_id":0, "workspace_id":0, "created_by":0}, which strips workspace_id from the returned document. Line ~460 then does `workspace_id = d.get('workspace_id')`, which evaluates to None. All three hydration branches build their lookup filters with that None value — db.products.find_one({'id': pid, 'workspace_id': None, ...}) and db.coupons.find_one({'code': code, 'workspace_id': None}) — which match zero documents, so block.props.product and block.props.coupon are never populated. There is no exception and no log line, so the failure is completely silent. REPRODUCTION: login as admin@promoos.com, GET /api/public/f/qa-storefront-live, inspect the product block -> props = {'product_id': '2b47512b-d35d-4a02-b611-0dd7a2fc4b50', 'coupon_code': 'VIPELITJRIXE'} with no 'product'/'coupon' keys; the browser at /f/qa-storefront-live correspondingly shows 'Buy now' + 'Product image' placeholder and no price. Same for the diamond coupon block (test_coupon_block_hydration_regression). MITIGATION: remove workspace_id from the projection so it is returned, keep the existing `d.pop('workspace_id', None)` at the end of the function to keep it out of the public payload. The giftcard branch is unaffected because it resolves from a static TEMPLATES list, which is why the bug was not caught by earlier iterations.
